name: open-island-transit-data
title: Open Island Transit Data
description: Island Transit's (Whidbey and Camano Islands, Washington) GTFS-Realtime feeds, saved every 20 seconds since November 19, 2026, with daily measures of the feed's quality and on-time figures inferred from vehicle positions.

conventions.pacificFields: hours of the day (by_hour, start_hour), day_type and passio_time
conventions.missing: an empty cell in CSV files, null in Parquet and JSON files

fields.name: service_date
fields.description: The service day

fields.name: service_expected
fields.description: False on a holiday with no service (`reference/no-service-days.csv`)

fields.name: passio_version
fields.description: Static version the day was measured against

fields.name: scheduled_trips
fields.description: Passio trips scheduled that day (on the first day, only those still running when collection began)

fields.name: trip_coverage
fields.description: Share of those trips with at least one vehicle position within 30 minutes of the trip's schedule

fields.name: vehicle_uptime
fields.description: Share of 20-second slots with a successful fetch. Slots are centered on the moment the scheduler usually fires

fields.name: trip_update_uptime
fields.description: Share of 20-second slots with a successful fetch. Slots are centered on the moment the scheduler usually fires

fields.name: vehicle_fetch_failure_rate
fields.description: Share of vehicle-position fetches that failed

fields.name: empty_in_service_rate
fields.description: Successful vehicle-position fetches with no vehicles, while a trip was scheduled

fields.name: stale_in_service_rate
fields.description: Successful vehicle-position fetches that listed vehicles but whose newest vehicle timestamp was over 120 s old, while a trip was scheduled. An empty fetch is counted as empty, not stale

fields.name: longest_gap_s_median
fields.description: Median over observed trips of the longest interval between new position reports from the trip's main vehicle, within 30 minutes of its schedule

fields.name: position_age_s_median
fields.description: Time from the vehicle's timestamp to the first fetch that returned it; each position counted once

fields.name: position_age_s_p95
fields.description: Time from the vehicle's timestamp to the first fetch that returned it; each position counted once

fields.name: impossible_jumps
fields.description: Consecutive reports of one vehicle implying more than 130 km/h (about 80 mph)

fields.name: timepoint_coverage
fields.description: Scheduled timepoint events with an inferred time

fields.name: stop_coverage
fields.description: The same at every stop

fields.name: off_shape_share
fields.description: Position reports more than 100 meters (about 330 feet) from the trip's shape, divided by the reports tracked along it

fields.name: prediction_mae_s_5min
fields.description: Mean absolute error of arrival predictions published 5 minutes ahead, seconds

fields.name: prediction_median_abs_s_5min
fields.description: The typical miss of those predictions: the median absolute error, seconds

fields.name: prediction_over_30min_share_5min
fields.description: Share of those predictions off by more than 30 minutes

fields.name: prediction_within_60s_5min
fields.description: Share of those predictions within 60 s

fields.name: jitter_m_p95
fields.description: 95th percentile of position spread while a bus stands at a terminal, meters

fields.name: unassignable_trip_ids
fields.description: Trip ids reported that are not in the static version or not scheduled that day

fields.name: vehicles_missing_vs_30d
fields.description: Vehicles seen in the previous 30 days (with quality files) but not this day

fields.name: trip_id_match_rate
fields.description: Positions whose `trip_id` exists in the static version

fields.name: over_coverage_share
fields.description: Positions with no trip, an unknown trip, or a trip not scheduled that day

fields.name: vehicle_latency_ms_median
fields.description: Median response time of the vehicle-position feed

fields.name: vehicles_seen
fields.description: Distinct vehicles reporting

fields.name: timetable_reference
fields.description: Effective date of the printed timetable used for timepoints

fields.name: timepoint_names_resolved_share
fields.description: Printed timepoint names tied to a Passio stop

fields.name: canceled_trips
fields.description: Scheduled trips the feed marked as canceled, by a flag on the trip or by a `NO_SERVICE` alert naming it

fields.name: trip_coverage_excluding_canceled
fields.description: Trip coverage with the canceled trips that no bus reported taken out of the scheduled trips. Equal to `trip_coverage` when nothing was canceled

fields.name: trip_update_changed_share
fields.description: Of the pairs of consecutive fetches that both listed a trip, the share in which the trip's update had changed

fields.name: trip_update_interval_s_median
fields.description: Typical time between the feed's timestamps on two successive updates of a trip, seconds

fields.name: passio_basis
fields.description: How the day's Passio version was chosen (see `manifest/static.json`)

fields.name: passio_changed_during_day
fields.description: True when complete Passio downloads on that day differed, which marks a schedule change

fields.name: glitch_reports_removed
fields.description: Position reports left out as GPS glitches: a bus jumping somewhere impossible and back (`measurement.glitches` in the day file). Since `quality/0.6.0`

fields.name: unresolved_jumps
fields.description: Impossible jumps that were not left out, because there was no jump back or the bus could have made it by driving fast (often a timestamp a few seconds off). Since `quality/0.6.0`

fields.name: complete
fields.description: False when the day's quality file was written before its stop events existed; the nightly catch-up and the watchdog then treat the day as not processed, and the next run rebuilds it. Since `quality/0.6.1`

fields.name: stop_distance_m
fields.description: The stop's distance along the trip's shape; empty if the stop is `unplaced`. Where two points on one stretch of the shape are equally near the stop, the earlier one (since `events/0.3.1`)

fields.name: stop_offset_m
fields.description: How far the stop sits from the shape at that point, in meters (since `events/0.3.0`)

fields.name: arrival_gap_s
fields.description: Seconds between the two position reports the time was interpolated from

fields.name: arrival_status
fields.description: `observed`; `gap` (reports more than 120 s apart, no time given); `not_reached` (tracking ended before the stop); `past_when_first_seen`; `skipped` (the bus left out the part of the shape the stop is on); `no_shape` (the trip has no shape); `unplaced` (the stop could not be placed on the shape in stop order within 150 m of it); `no_reports` (no vehicle carried the trip id); `not_applicable` (no arrival at the first stop, no departure at the last)

fields.name: departure_time
fields.description: When it moved more than 40 meters past the stop

fields.name: departure_gap_s
fields.description: Seconds between the two position reports the time was interpolated from

fields.name: departure_status
fields.description: `observed`; `gap` (reports more than 120 s apart, no time given); `not_reached` (tracking ended before the stop); `past_when_first_seen`; `skipped` (the bus left out the part of the shape the stop is on); `no_shape` (the trip has no shape); `unplaced` (the stop could not be placed on the shape in stop order within 150 m of it); `no_reports` (no vehicle carried the trip id); `not_applicable` (no arrival at the first stop, no departure at the last)

fields.name: report_source
fields.description: Where the two position reports that timed this stop came from (the least direct of them if the arrival and departure differ): `own` (the trip's own id), `borrowed_before` (the same bus before its first report under this trip's id, often still showing the previous trip's id at the first stop), `borrowed_after` (the same bus after its last report under this trip's id, often already showing the next trip's id), `borrowed_within` (the same bus between them, with no trip id or another one). Empty when the stop was not observed. Since `events/0.5.0` (`docs/methods.md`, section 3)

fields.name: reports_borrowed_after
fields.description: Reports of the same bus under another trip id or none that the trip also used: before its first own report (from 30 minutes before its start, or the end of the bus's previous trip if later), after its last own report (up to 30 minutes after its end, but not past the moment the bus left its next trip's first stop), and in between. `position_reports` counts only its own. Since `events/0.5.0`

fields.name: reports_borrowed_within
fields.description: Reports of the same bus under another trip id or none that the trip also used: before its first own report (from 30 minutes before its start, or the end of the bus's previous trip if later), after its last own report (up to 30 minutes after its end, but not past the moment the bus left its next trip's first stop), and in between. `position_reports` counts only its own. Since `events/0.5.0`
